column1: # Source: written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later); the sources of the constraint-* rows are single words of the Irish Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) or UD Irish-IDT (CC BY-SA 3.0), listed as test inputs. Run with the pack's defaults: the optional addMissingFada processor is off, so a word written without its síneadh fada is not read as one with it.
# Constraint rows that the optional addMissingFada processor would pass with every option on (a variant with í reaches the same text through another rule).
# A pin: céanna is also the plural of cé "quay" in wty-ga-en, but the plural rule's constraint keeps the adjective "same" from being read as it (the dictionary still gives cé, second).
